notes.note: Differences between the two Create POA Account Operator scripts (not byte-identical; dupes.json is empty): the customer-account flow sets gen_customeraccount (EntityReference gen_customeraccount ← gen_customeraccountid) and its error buffer carries customerAccountGuid; the pension flow sets gen_policy (EntityReference gen_policies ← gen_policiesid) and carries policyGuid. All other 20 attributes and logic are the same (pension code lines shifted +1).

Five status updaters run in order (DTSX 18795-18799): link expiry (4) → operator cancelled when all links cancelled (6) → invalid when all invalid (5) → expired when all expired (4) → finally cancelled (6) when no link is valid (all != 2). The last step catches mixed non-valid sets (e.g. some expired + some invalid) and labels them "cancelled". Component "Update Poa Operator Cancelled" in data flow "Update Poa Operator Expired By Poa Account" actually writes 4 (expired) — the name is misleading.

Status values are literals created by Derived Columns (expiredStatus/ExpiredStatus = 4, CancelStatus/CancelledStatus = 6, InvalidStatus = 5); meanings (2 valid, 4 expired, 5 invalid, 6 cancelled) come from SQL comments in the package, not from CRM metadata (unverified option-set labels).

All five status updaters use ExecuteMultipleExtension (external CRM.Proxy assembly, external_unknown) in batches of 500; per-item faults are ignored (ErrorBuffer lines commented out), so failed updates are silent. The final flush (Input0_ProcessInput) is outside try/catch — an exception there fails the data flow.

Create flows: permission flags are only ever written as true; when gen_allpermissions is true the 12 detailed flags are not sent at all. Dates (signature/start/receiving/end) are copied from the POA operator without conversion.

Create flows: duplicate protection is only "no POA account operator exists for this customer account / policy" (any POA operator, any status). If the employer has several valid POA operators, the same new customer account/policy produces several rows in the same run and all pass the partial-cache lookup (records are created after lookup) → several links; a customer account/policy that already has an expired/cancelled link never gets a new one.
Create flows read only records created in the last 2 days (DATEADD(dd,-2,GETDATE())); if the package does not run for >2 days, older new accounts/policies are never linked.

Pension flow: Gen_identitynumber is wstr(9) whereas the customer-account flow uses Gen_customeridnumber wstr(20); the employee lookup compares to gen_poaemployeeemployeroperator.gen_identitynumber as-is (no padding/trim).
ETL Warning scripts, Failed-To-Update Derived Columns and Error outputs are ETL plumbing (not mapped). No direct SQL DML on CRM in this package; [psql] = psql/altshuler_mscrm is used read-only.
